title: refactor(ci): modernize and unify lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & matrix
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: our repo has accreted ~6 different GH Actions workflows for lint/test/release over the past 3 years. This causes long CI configuration drift, duplicated steps, and inconsistent caching/matrix shapes across repos. This PR unifies lint/test/release workflows into a smaller set of composable workflows and reuses centralized workflow templates where possible. Goals: 1) reduce overall CI runtime and queue pressure, 2) improve cache hit rates by standardizing restore/save keys and layers, 3) reduce maintenance surface by consolidating matrix permutations and applying per-package splits only when necessary, 4) keep release automation predictable and decoupled from test pipelines. Summary of changes: consolidated 6 workflows -> 2 primary workflows + reusable templates, upgraded Node job runners to node:20 images for JS SDK build/test steps, normalized Python setup across workflows, switched from a repo-level monolithic matrix to target-sliced matrices for large monorepo targets (packages/core, packages/sdk-python, packages/sdk-js, examples), added more granular caching (actions/cache layered by pnpm store / pip wheel cache / poetry cache), added a fast-path lint run that runs on push to feature branches and a stricter lint+typechecker on PR against main, reduced duplication in release workflow by extracting reusable steps into .github/actions/release-helpers/*, introduced a GH action that gates release notes generation on changelog labels and Linear links. Checklist: - [x] consolidate workflows and add templates - [x] standardize Node/Python versions across jobs - [x] improve cache keys and restore/save ordering - [x] add target-slicing for large matrices - [x] run smoke e2e only on release candidates - [x] update docs/CI.md with new workflows Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor CI queue and cache hit metrics for 72 hours, revert or scope-back any job that causes >2x slowdown for specific packages. Related: ENG-1324 (CI run cost), ENG-1378 (release flakiness).
commits: feat(ci): add reusable workflow templates for lint and test
perf(ci): implement target-slicing matrix for large monorepo packages
chore(ci): bump node versions to 20 for js jobs
refactor(ci): extract release helper actions and update release workflow
docs: update docs/CI.md with new workflow overview and rollback plan
review_conversation: Elliot Ramirez (reviewer): Left a comment suggesting we keep the Node 18 fallback for critical jobs until we verify runner images in our cloud provider. - Author: added a Node 18 fallback matrix entry for the three critical jobs (build/test/release) and documented the fallback in CI.md.

Samir Patel (reviewer): Asked for clearer cache key semantics to avoid cross-job pollution between pnpm store and workspace cache. - Author: updated cache keys to include job-specific suffixes and package-target hashes; added .github/cache-keys.md to document conventions.

Jesse Kim (reviewer): Noted that release automation previously relied on a custom internal action; asked to preserve signing and changelog flow. - Author: extracted signing and changelog steps into new release-helpers actions; preserved existing flags and added integration tests in release workflow.
Elliot Ramirez (approval): Approved after Node18 fallback added and cache docs were updated.
merge_outcome: Squash and merge to main. Merge strategy: squash commits, add concise release note. Post-merge actions: tagged main with ci/unify-2026-02, monitored CI metrics for 72h; no rollback required.
release_notes: Refactor CI: unified lint/test/release workflows, improved caching and matrix sizing, bumped Node to 20 for JS CI jobs, added reusable release helper actions to stabilize release automation. Impact: lower CI runtime and fewer config diffs; no breaking changes to developer workflow.
